name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd.
about: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited engages in wealth management, asset management and services, and capital markets businesses in India and internationally. It operates through wealth management, asset management, and capital markets segments. The company offers financial products, investment advisory, lending against securities and securities broking services; investment management services for alternative investment funds; and portfolio management services. It is also involved in the institutional broking and merchant banking businesses, as well as provision of advisory and clearing services. The company was formerly known as Edelweiss Securities Limited and changed its name to Nuvama Wealth Management Limited in August 2022. Nuvama Wealth Management Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India. Nuvama Wealth Management Limited operates as a subsidiary of PAGAC Ecstasy

verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: Price implies only ~17% a year growth, below the ~21% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
Trades at PE 30 vs sector median 20; peers with similar ROE and growth trade nearer 20, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 52% a year while PE moved 29 → 30.
